verdict.rationale: The Department publishes a downloadable Reemployment Tax XML Package containing Florida XML Schemas and an XPath document for its electronic file-and-pay channel, which is a first-party machine-readable specification. It is documented only for reemployment tax, and the Batch Enrollment Technical Specifications are gated behind an email request rather than published. Missing for 10: openly published specs for the other machine channels (batch enrollment specs require an emailed access request), coverage beyond reemployment tax, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the schema package contents.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary

citations.quote: The XPath document and Florida XML Schemas have been updated to include additional E-Verify certification fields. Download the Reemployment Tax XML Package
The Department has established an electronic file and pay program for entities submitting large data files with reemployment tax information.
To request access to the Batch Enrollment Technical Specifications, send an email
